factual_fidelity.evidence: 'three-bedroom row house, constructed in the 1980s, offers 130 m²' aligns with inputs.

completeness.evidence: Covers beds, bath, sqm, garden, parking, cellar, shed; doesn't mention rental status.

native_quality.evidence: Reads naturally, e.g. 'offers 130 m² of living space within a quiet residential area'.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE supplied and description omits CPE.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 11 words with neighborhood; 5 hashtags but generic ones like 'SuburbanLiving' and 'WellConnected'.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 2 — 'Lycée Josy Barthel' and 'European School Luxembourg II in Bertrange-Mamer' (no neighborhood data provided in inputs).

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: FR/EN say 'row house' / 'maison en rangée' while DE upgrades to 'Reiheneckhaus' (end-row house) — a feature-list disagreement on property sub-type; numerics (130 m², 3 beds, 1 bath) agree across all three.
